result.summary: Found 2 issues: one major layout truncation issue and one minor content issue.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant name in the 'Fastest near you' section is visually truncated/cut off at the right edge of the screen. The card is partially visible, suggesting the text and card are being clipped without a clear scroll affordance indicator.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the partially visible card has a more obvious visual cue (e.g., a shadow or arrow) indicating horizontal scrollability, and make sure the restaurant name truncates gracefully with an ellipsis rather than being hard-clipped.

issues.description: The last item in the 'Popular right now' section shows a '-0%' badge on the pizza restaurant card, which appears to be a broken or meaningless discount label (0% discount is not meaningful to users).
issues.suggestion: Fix the discount calculation logic to avoid displaying '-0%'. Either hide the badge when the discount is 0% or ensure valid discount values are shown.
